prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Flocks of birds in pairs line the roof of a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, three young men in silhouette seen from behind standing on the ground below looking up, more pairs of birds wheeling in the sky. Morning, a grey sky full of wings. Wondrous and still. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth.
